Chedaśāsra
or Chedanavati. Jain. Pkt. Pannalal Bombay I. p. 65. (Pt..).
Pt.. in a collection Prāyaścittasaṅgraha, Mānik. Dig. Jain.

Chedasūtra
Jain. general name for the following six canonical texts: Niśīha, Mahāniśīha, Vavahāra, Daśāśrutaskandha, Bṛhatkalpa an. Jītakalpa. See under the separate titles.

Pt.. Moradabad, 1903. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 646.
